title: Polynomial-time parity-query policies for explicit Boolean polynomials
description: Research preprint with PDF, LaTeX source, exact evaluator diagnostic and document checks. An attributed construction based on Zhang and Moshkovitz-Zhu gives an on-demand parity-query policy for an explicit Boolean ANF. For every fixed hidden input, correctness and min(n,O(1+4^d log(s) log(nd))) queries hold jointly with probability at least 1-delta. Total bit time and working space are polynomial in ambient n, original encoding length and log(1/delta), with fixed exponents independent of degree and an explicit precision interface. All tapes terminate and use at most n queries. A factor-partition identity handles Boolean collisions before exterior evaluation; a proved spectral-norm gap justifies a read-all cutoff that pays the exponential tables. The all-coset polynomial-time one-batch theorem is retained. No improved existential query bound, globally correct sampled tree, established priority, independent peer review or formal certification is claimed. The exact diagnostic is not a complete-policy implementation. OpenAI Codex assisted derivation, source comparison, drafting and package preparation.
